library.name: PAC1xxx
library.author: Jobit Joseph
library.sentence: Arduino library for Microchip PAC1711, PAC1721, PAC1761, PAC1811, PAC1821 and PAC1861 power monitors.
library.paragraph: Measures bus voltage, current, power, energy and charge over I2C. Detects the connected part automatically and configures full-scale ranges and ADC width to match. Supports bipolar current sensing, the sample-rate and averaging controls, the limit and alert registers, and both blocking and non-blocking operation. Based on the PAC1711 C HAL published by Microchip Technology Inc.
